body: ## Description The test failed since it was trying to interact with a node that react had removed Robot detailed description: The form remounts its controls each time it toggles processing state. The add button is only rendered while the list is enabled, so a processing toggle replaces that node. userEvent yields between locating a node and dispatching to it, so on a loaded runner the click landed on a node React had already replaced and never reached the handler. The editor stayed shut, and the wait for child-panel timed out with the list still empty. Locate and click in one synchronous step, and retry until the editor is open. Raise the async budget to 5s and the test timeout to 20s as well: 1s is too tight for a full form render on a loaded runner, and a longer wait would otherwise hit Vitest's 5s cap. ## Checklist: - [x] I have done a self review of my code. - [ ] I have updated the documentation / READMEs where necessary. - [ ] I have added tests to cover my changes. - [ ] All new and existing tests passed. - [ ] I have looked for existing abstractions (helper functions, React components) that AI-generated code may not be using - [ ] (Frontend Only) I have included a screen recording of the existing/desired behavior. ## Deploy Label _(Pilot Users Only)_ ---
title: [CON-2387] Stop childSaveAutoSave losing its click to a remount
